verdict.rationale: The only spend-control evidence is scoped to the AI Gateway, which documents budgets and spending controls for model calls. Nothing shows hard spending caps for the wider Vercel platform (compute, bandwidth, functions). A community report of surprise $10k bills during undetected DDoS suggests platform-level costs are not reliably capped, but it does not contradict a specific vendor claim. Missing for 10: platform-wide hard spending limits, documented automatic pause/shutdown when a cap is hit, billing alerts beyond AI Gateway, independent corroboration that budgets are enforced as hard limits.
